title: Time-LLM: Time Series Forecasting by Reprogramming Large Language Models

claim.summary: Time-LLM reprograms temporal patches through learned text prototypes, adds prompt prefixes, and projects a frozen LLM output into forecasts.

modules.name: Trainable patch reprogramming around a frozen LLM
modules.scope_reason: Learned input/prototype and output transformations adapt the model representation even though backbone weights remain frozen.
